item.title: 7 Cozy Fall Decor Ideas for Small Apartments (Renter-Friendly)
item.description: Want your apartment to feel warmer as the days get shorter, without adding clutter? These 7 fall decor ideas use texture, warm light and a few swaps instead of piles of new stuff. Everything works in a rental and in a small room. Save this for your autumn refresh.

item.title: 6 Cozy Reading Nook Ideas for Small Apartments
item.description: No spare room for a reading corner? These 6 cozy reading nook ideas fit into a window, a corner or even a closet. Simple pieces, warm light and soft textures. Save this for your next cozy weekend project.
